description: This file contains unit tests for the ControlService component, verifying behaviors such as acknowledgment, application state setting, and ping functionality within the control service. It uses Google Test framework macros and fixtures.

methods.name: shouldNotAckWithoutAddedControl
methods.description: Test that acknowledgment is false when no control has been added.

methods.name: shouldNotSetApplicationStateWithoutAddedControl
methods.description: Test that setting application state does not occur without a control being added.

methods.name: shouldNotAckWithUnknownControlId
methods.description: Test that acknowledgment fails for an unknown control ID.

methods.name: shouldNotAckWithRemovedControlId
methods.description: Test that acknowledgment fails after the control has been removed.

methods.name: shouldNotSetApplicationStateWithRemovedControlId
methods.description: Test that setting application state fails if the control has been removed.

methods.name: shouldAck
methods.description: Test that acknowledgment succeeds when the control is properly added and acknowledged.

methods.name: shouldSetApplicationState
methods.description: Test that application state can be set successfully for an added control.

methods.name: shouldSetApplicationStateForNewControl
methods.description: Test that application state can be set immediately after creating a new control.

methods.name: shouldPing
methods.description: Test that the ping operation works correctly for the control.
